flora: Mature Magnolia trees (large spreading canopy, dotted with white flowers)
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; rounded toy-like proportions; majestic and ancient forest feel; emphasizing the 'flowering forest' aesthetic; no sharp aggressive angles; lush and inviting.

visual_logic.composition: A wide-angle view of a sun-drenched Magnolia grove. The ground is a mix of brown earth and forest-green moss. The trees are heavy with large white blossoms, and the air has a slight hazy glow, emphasizing a warm, humid afternoon.
visual_logic.ground: Deep brown siltstone soil covered in a layer of fallen leaves and moss.
visual_logic.lighting: Warm, direct sunlight creating high-contrast highlights on the glossy leaves and soft shadows across the forest floor.
